title: Driver signability gate discovers Inf2Cat like build-driver

summary.behavior: tools/driver-signability-check.ps1 now resolves Inf2Cat.exe with explicit precedence: WDK_BIN override first, then a recursive Windows Kits bin-tree search matching build-driver.ps1, then PATH. When all locations miss, the gate still fails closed.
summary.scope_boundary: Host-side tooling only. No driver source behavior change, no guest installation, load, start, signing, or real-device changes.

validation.result: pass (13 cases; precedence order and all-missing fail-closed outcome covered offline)
